SourceActivities: 18.2 Obstacle Course two maps with continuous collision constraints

Task.Prompt: On original coordinate paper map, take two labelled triangles safely around rectangular obstacle by rigid-motion sequences. Show each intermediate image and prove ALL swept positions remain outside obstacle and within map, then describe pointwise alignment for a congruent parallelogram.

Criteria.Criterion: both source-style start/goal figures and allowed intermediate images correctly mapped
all moving-figure swept positions avoid solid obstacle at each step
no figure leaves map boundary during any continuous motion
pointwise parallelogram mapping and full labelled transformation reasoning

Practice.Prompt: Map first triangle from (1,1),(2,1),(1,2) to (8,8),(9,8),(8,9) while avoiding obstacle x4-6,y3-7.
Practice.Expected: Up 7 then right 7; first all x<=2, then all y>=8, so swept figure avoids obstacle.

Practice.Prompt: What is image of (2,1) after 90° clockwise about (0,0), then translation (3,1)?
Reflect triangle across x-axis and translate by (2,3); image of (1,2)?
Which motion sends any A to any B in plane?
How do congruent triangles align systematically?
Practice.Expected: Translate first vertex, rotate around it for second, reflect in their line if needed for third.

Practice.Prompt: A quadrilateral has rotational symmetry taking every vertex to any other. What follows?
Practice.Expected: It is a square; all four sides and angles equal under quarter-turn symmetry.

Practice.Prompt: A quadrilateral has reflection symmetry. Must it have all equal sides?
Practice.Expected: No; a non-square rectangle has reflection symmetry without all sides equal.

FirstPartyCooldown: EDULYTIKS_AUTHORED_COOLDOWN: prove up-then-right is collision-free but direct diagonal move is not
PaperHandoff: Teacher receives path diagrams and written continuous-clearance arguments, scores each rubric dimension 0/1/2 and signs/date feedback on paper.

Cases.CORRECT: each swept triangle avoids obstacle and boundary and ends correctly matched
Cases.EQUIVALENT: alternate fully safe continuous motions, with each clearance justified
Cases.WRONG: checks only endpoints or passes through solid obstacles during motion
Cases.INSUFFICIENT: only arrows or target triangles without intermediate/clearance arguments
Cases.MALFORMED: obstacle/map not specified or intersecting initial position
